label: measured: 3 live re-plan run(s), local client against a running API process with backend=vertex
method: p50/p95 are nearest-rank (sort ascending, take the ceil(p/100*n)-th value, 1-indexed) over each run's time_to_done_s -- client wall-clock seconds from the moment POST /rerun was sent to the 'event: done' SSE message. fallback_rate is the share of runs whose done payload's source is 'deterministic_rules'. mean_tokens is the mean of each run's run_summary usage.total_token_count (from GET /events/{run_id}), over the runs that reported one.
